# Oeste — Huntington

A component reference for humans, AI agents, and vibe coders.
Oeste — Three libraries. Three lenses. Huntington = second public library: a single-column index with five moods, hairlines instead of shadows, and no filled button.

## Usage
Use semantic HTML, explicit labels, keyboard interaction, and visible focus. Never use color alone to communicate state. All demos are local; nothing leaves your browser. Install components from the shadcn registry: `npx shadcn@latest add https://oeste.hiddeninwest.com/huntington/r/<id>.json` (index at /huntington/r/registry.json, manifest at /huntington/components.json). The registry is live at https://oeste.hiddeninwest.com/huntington/r/ — install via shadcn, or copy from the Vibe lens. Registry files are self-contained React + Tailwind and need huntington/src/tokens.css loaded once. `@oeste/huntington` is not a published package. Snippets import from `@/components/ui/…` — where shadcn puts the files. Paste snippets into an existing React + Tailwind app with React in scope. Use the complete contract below when generating UI.

## Tokens (single source of truth)
Tokens live in src/tokens.css + src/tokens.json + DESIGN_TOKENS in src/index.js and agree exactly.
- Paper: paper #f6f4f1, card #fffdf9, ink #1c1917, body rgba(28,25,23,0.86), muted #756e6a, line rgba(28,25,23,0.1)
- Ink: paper #151412, card #1e1d1b, ink #f0ede8, body rgba(240,237,232,0.86), muted #a09a93, line rgba(240,237,232,0.14)
- Rose: paper #f8efeb, card #fffbf9, ink #2a211d, body rgba(42,33,29,0.86), muted #7a6a62, line rgba(42,33,29,0.1)
- Sage: paper #edf0ea, card #fbfdfa, ink #1d211c, body rgba(29,33,28,0.86), muted #676e67, line rgba(29,33,28,0.1)
- Dune: paper #f3e9d7, card #faf3e4, ink #2b2114, body rgba(43,33,20,0.86), muted #76674b, line rgba(43,33,20,0.12)
- Accents (all moods): live #d24247, pulse #1a73e8, status Active #34d399 / Idle #60a5fa / Offline #fbbf24, orbs default #ff6b1a / blue #7aa2d9 / rose #d9b5a3 / green #9dc08b, logoCardDark #141210. Amount up / down are per-mood: Paper #1f7e5c / #b25151, Ink #34d399 / #f87171, Rose #1e7b5a / #ae5050, Sage #1e7a59 / #ad4f4f, Dune #1d7757 / #a84d4d
- Type: Manrope only, variable 400-800, no italics. 20 text styles; H1 31/700/-0.03/1.22, Lede 26/500/1.28/-0.025 (34px at >=700px), Page Title 26/600/1.28/-0.025, Section Title 17/700/-0.01, body 16/1.65.
- Spacing scale: 0/2/3/4/6/7/8/9/10/12/14/16/18/20/22/28/40/44/64/80. Layout: max width 672, side padding 20 (0 at 700px+), section padding-top 44, page padding-bottom 64. Radii: card/photo/tile/carousel 14, Logo Card 18, grid art 10, Progress Bar 2, menu-sheet top 22, pill 999. Shadows: cards none (hairline); Menu Pill 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.14); Menu Bottom Sheet 0 -18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.16). One breakpoint: 700px. Touch targets: min 44px for primary actions; compact inline controls (Filter Pill, Status Pill, Tag, text links) are source-faithful compact sizes.
- Muted-text contrast (measured, honest): muted meets 4.5:1 on paper and card in every mood (paper 4.56 to 4.58, card 4.93 to 5.13; Ink 6.61 / 6.05). Muted is for secondary/caption text. LIVE text is 4.48:1 on a paper card / 3.70:1 on an ink card. It is a status indicator with a dot, never body copy.
- Absent by design: no filled primary button, no toast, no dialog. One form control: Search filters a list; it never submits one. Actions are Text Link, Filter Pill, View All, Menu Pill, and rows that are real links/buttons.

## System prompt for AI editors
You are implementing Huntington UI in a React + Tailwind application. Read the Huntington manifest and the selected component contract before generating code. Use the Huntington tokens (5 moods via data-theme) and Manrope typography. Components use var() token classes so they follow the active mood — never hardcode a mood's colors — use only the Huntington tokens. Preserve native semantics, accessible names, visible focus, and reduced-motion preferences. Implement all documented keyboard behaviors. Never invent component props or package exports beyond the contract. Never invent a filled Button, toast, or a dialog — Huntington has none. The only form control is Search. Keep demos local and never add authentication or network writes. Include an executable usage example and keyboard tests. If the reference CLI is unavailable, use the dependency-light React snippets. Return code and a short accessibility checklist.

## Components (v0.2.0)
- Header — Wordmark left, mood control right. The top of every page.
- Mood Button — One dot. Five moods. Tap to cycle.
- Live Hero — Headline + sub. The live moment, up top.
- Lede — The standfirst that sets the page. Big, quiet, one thought.
- Standfirst — Body copy that opens a page. One paragraph, room to breathe.
- Page Title — A page's name + its meta. Smaller than a hero, firmer than a heading.
- Section Title — A section's name, an optional note, and a hairline underneath.
- List Row — A full-width row: title, description, and an optional meta. Inline (two columns without meta, three with it) or stacked (title + meta, description below). The index's workhorse.
- Status Row — Label + value, one line. Status at a glance.
- Playlist Row — Thumb + title + meta, with a track list that unfolds.
- Favorite Accordion — A favorite that opens into label/value detail rows.
- Q&A Accordion — Question up top, answer underneath. One at a time, plain words.
- Photo Card — A gradient card with an orb and a label. Four moods of the same card.
- File Grid Cell — One file in a grid: art, filename, meta.
- Logo Cell — A centered logo in a card cell. Quiet, even, 160 wide.
- Logo Card — A big centered mark. The logo gets the whole card.
- Carousel — A horizontal scroll-snap row of tall images.
- Photo Tile — Square art, a name, a category. The smallest photo unit.
- Gallery — A named group of photos: heading, count, three-across grid.
- Filter Pill — A filter you can tap. Inactive is outline, active is ink.
- Status Pill — A status with a dot. Text carries it; the dot echoes it.
- Status Dot — Inline status: a dot and a word. For sentences, not pills.
- Tag — A small uppercase label. Quiet metadata, hairline border.
- LIVE Badge — A red dot and the word LIVE. Small, loud, honest about its contrast.
- Reaction Button — A circle to tap, a label, a caption. Voted gets an underline.
- Text Link — The call to action. Bold ink, a 2px underline, nothing else.
- Back Link — One quiet way back. Muted, small, arrow included.
- View All — A full-width pill that opens the whole list.
- Progress Bar — A 3px bar. The number lives in the text next to it.
- Menu Pill — The floating pill that opens the menu sheet.
- Lightbox — One photo, big, on near-black. Prev, next, count, close.
- Menu Bottom Sheet — The menu, as a sheet: grab bar, sections, rows, active dot.
- Media Card — A full-bleed moment: status bar up top, caption at the bottom.
- Live Pulse Dot — An 8px dot and its expanding ring. Live, at a glance.
- Equalizer Bars — Four bars that say: something is playing.
- Stat — A metric, a big number, a unit. Nothing else.
- Footer — The bottom of the page. Small, muted, done.
- Toggle Tabs — Two or more views, one row. Active is ink + underline.
- Next Footer — The way onward. A hairline, then the next row.
- Calendar: Month grid. One button per day, min/max bounds.
- Date Picker: Read-only input plus popover calendar. Clear, Today.
- Time Picker: Trigger plus time listbox. 12-hour labels, HH:MM value.
- Date Range Picker: Two DatePickers, one range. End-before-start is an error.
- Chart: Bar, line, area, pie, donut. One series, SVG + data table.
- Data Grid: Sortable, filterable, pageable data grid.
- Patterns (not components) — Home page (Header + Live Hero + Start building + What Huntington means + Three lenses + Browse + Footer); Components page (Header + Page Title + List Rows + Footer); Detail page (Back Link + Page Title + Standfirst + Photo Card + Gallery + Reaction Button + Footer); Overlay flow (Menu Pill -> Menu Bottom Sheet + Lightbox); see Patterns

## Docs site
Static site in /huntington/site/ (index.html + styles.css + app.js, no build step, Vercel-ready). Routes: #/home, #/components, #/components/<id>?lens=human|agent|vibe, #/guides, #/tokens, #/getting-started, #/accessibility, #/patterns, #/changelog, #/migration, #/faq. Lens persists in the URL. Component contracts use oeste.component.v1. Guide: #/getting-started (install, moods, troubleshooting).

## Registry (v0.2.0)
shadcn-compatible registry at https://oeste.hiddeninwest.com/huntington/r/ — per-component items r/<id>.json ($schema ui.shadcn.com/schema/registry-item.json, type registry:ui, files[].content = self-contained React + Tailwind). The registry is live at https://oeste.hiddeninwest.com/huntington/r/. components.json in the library folder is the machine manifest: version, registryBase, components[] with id, name, description, registryUrl, githubRawUrl, docsUrl, tags. Registry files are generated by huntington/scripts/build_registry.py from src/index.js — never hand-edit r/*.json.
